title: BountyX
body:
🎯 BountyX
BountyX is a fully-featured bounty plugin for Minecraft servers, designed to bring an exciting player-hunting experience to your server!
⚔️ Features
🎯 Bounty System — Place bounties on any player with a custom amount of money
🔒 Public & Private Bounties — Public bounties can be redeemed by anyone, private bounties are assigned to a specific hunter
👥 Group System — Create a group of up to 5 hunters and split the reward equally when the target is eliminated
📖 Bounty List GUI — Beautiful paginated GUI with real player skins and detailed bounty information
🏙️ Towny Integration — Can't place bounties on members of your own town or nation
💰 Vault Support — Full economy integration
📊 PlaceholderAPI Support — Display bounty amounts in TAB list and other plugins with %bountyx_amount%
🗂️ TAB Integration — Wanted players are automatically shown in the TAB list with their bounty amount next to their name. Configure it in TAB's groups.yml using %bountyx_amount% and a condition to hide it when the bounty is 0.
⚙️ Fully Configurable — All messages can be customized in the config.yml
📋 Commands
CommandDescription/bounty <player> <amount>Place a bounty on a player/bounty listList all active bounties/bounty remove <player>Remove a bounty (admin)/bounty menuOpen the bounty GUI/bounty group createCreate a hunter group/bounty group invite <player>Invite a player to your group/bounty group acceptAccept a group invite
🔑 Permissions
PermissionDescriptionbounty.removeAllows removing bountiesbounty.redeemAllows redeeming bounties
🔧 Dependencies

Vault — Required
PlaceholderAPI — Optional
Towny — Optional
TAB — Optional

📦 Installation

Download the .jar file
Place it in your plugins/ folder
Restart the server
Configure config.yml to your liking
If using TAB, add %bountyx_amount% to your groups.yml with a condition to hide it when the value is 0
